svg.title: Sparse common-unit equation without sensory metaphor
svg.desc: On a neutral field, a restrained equation shows two thirds plus five eighths transforming to sixteen twenty-fourths plus fifteen twenty-fourths, then thirty-one twenty-fourths, then one and seven twenty-fourths. A note says the mathematics does not require a fixed representational identity.
svg.text: No strip, voice, or imagined workspace is required.

g.text: Same common-unit mathematics; reported format may differ or be absent.
